description:
HushTelegram v0.0.12 targets telegram.org's Telegram 12.10.6 (org.telegram.messenger.web) and the official beta 12.10.7 (org.telegram.messenger.beta) with 56 patches. It takes sponsored messages, search ads, Stories, recommendations and the Premium, gifts and Stars upsells out of Telegram, and keeps its usage reports on your phone. New this time: every patch description, settings row and message is rewritten in plain English, and Expert mode groups the patches the way you'd look for them. Keep deleted messages marks a message the moment it's deleted while the chat is open, and it can clear what it kept. On the beta, Disable analytics also stops Firebase's crash and session reports, and a new Turn off beta debug logs switch, off by default, stops the beta's always-on debug logs.

If Telegram won't send you a login code, register an app at my.telegram.org/apps and fill in Use registered Telegram API credentials before patching. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, then Notifications and Sounds, and turn on Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection.

Validation: 786 runtime tests passed locally. All 364 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 56 patches applied to Telegram 12.10.6 and the 12.10.7 beta without forcing, and the release receipt checked each patched app's manifest, native libraries and alignment.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch telegram.org's Telegram 12.10.6, version code 71129 (APKMirror lists it as Telegram (Web version), since telegram.org now serves 13.0.0), or the beta 12.10.7, version code 71239. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. Uninstall the stock Telegram first, and keep the manager's signing key for updates.
